candidates.reviewScope: visual-master-only; adoption authorizes new geometry/unlit/layer-board derivation, never direct runtime use or slicing

technicalClarifications.rule: The accepted 24x16 visual master must precede geometry, clean-state, cutaway, motion, effect, or prefab production; candidate03 passed two independent Sol reviews at 44/49 and 42/49.
technicalClarifications.reason: Preserves the user-mandated world-first ordering without confusing visual acceptance with runtime acceptance.

technicalClarifications.rule: Hidden interiors, mutually exclusive door states, and animation frames use derived whole-state boards after exterior approval; they may not be generated as unrelated individual assets.
technicalClarifications.reason: A single flattened exterior PNG cannot contain hidden or mutually exclusive visual states.

technicalClarifications.rule: The declared 57 PNG set is retained exactly as coreAssets, while visually required furniture, lamps, hearth glow, and runtime UI usage are tracked separately and cannot be omitted to preserve the count.
technicalClarifications.reason: Fable5VerticalSlice and PlacementGuide require them in the visible cutaway and dialogue flow.

technicalClarifications.rule: The dialogue UI uses the retained byte-identical source sheet through documented fixed crops and 9-slices; it is not counted as a newly generated PNG.
technicalClarifications.reason: The user-provided source already exists and full-sheet stretching is forbidden.

technicalClarifications.rule: The current target-town image overrides conflicting legacy palette, contrast, sparse-road, and four-building-only composition limits.
technicalClarifications.reason: The user explicitly selected the newer image as the higher-quality basis and authorized overwriting existing visual criteria.

technicalClarifications.rule: Runtime background authority is the exact user-direct 1586x992 target-town raster with no resampling. Candidate03 remains generated visual and geometry evidence only. Existing 1536x1024 coordinates are not silently reused; they require explicit remapping to target-town pixels.
technicalClarifications.reason: The user's whole-image-background authorization applies to the directly supplied image, not to a different generated candidate.

technicalClarifications.rule: The generated candidate03 master is a lit RGB composite and may never be runtime-loaded under the user-direct authorization. The exact target-town image may be loaded as background, while only gameplay-required state and occlusion pieces are derived or overlaid.
technicalClarifications.reason: Direct background use and generated-candidate promotion are separate decisions; only the first was authorized.

contractDefects.detail: Terrain variant sheet canonical IDs and layouts are not specified; manifest IDs are provisional containers with explicit containedAssetIds.
Most prop, roof, door, shadow, overlay, and effect PNG dimensions and pivots are absent from the source documents and remain null until board geometry fixes exact crops.
Dialogue source crops, safe insets, native display scale, and output paths are measured and recorded under runtimeSourceUsage; derived PNG materialization and browser verification remain pending.
N2, N8, N9, and SSIM implementation thresholds beyond the stated acceptance values require explicit QA implementation and evidence.

The new 24x16 door cells/opening rectangles/approach cells, contact footprints, pivots, collision polygons, y-sort anchors, occluder ownership, and hidden-background regions require an approved geometry overlay. A lighting-only whole-board edit may proceed after Gate A because it cannot change geometry; legacy 18x12 coordinates and RGB envelopes are forbidden collision substitutes.
